title: Customer feature and RSU questions
summary: This topic is dominated by customer inquiries about vehicle features, controls, updates, and RSU notifications, with only a small number of fragments explicitly mentioning an RSU problem.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to brief mentions of a problem with RSU without further detail.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly record customers asking how features work or whether capabilities are available, including preconditioning, maps, recording, buttons, and openings.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined question-style notes rather than evaluative feedback, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The topic mixes several unrelated subjects such as RSU, preconditioning, navigation updates, buttons, recorder functions, and physical vehicle operations.
The negative examples are very brief and do not provide enough detail to identify the underlying RSU issue.
